doc: Earth: westerlies 12 m/s on the storm track (x = 1.5, 45 degrees), trades -7 m/s (x = 0.45), weak polar easterlies beyond x = 2.1 (smoothstep to -4), symmetric in latitude (|lat|). 181 float64 latitudes -90..90 every degree. Float64 closed form (gaussians, a smoothstep, a scale): rtol 1e-9. Arguments: lat (input, rad), hadley_deg and body (params). Measured: one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 1.8e-14 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is about 8e3x that spread.
